item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] The suspect in the deadly Berlin Pride attack is killed in a confrontation with police
item.description: BERLIN (AP) — The suspect in the deadly Berlin Pride attack that left one person dead and 29 injured was shot and killed by police during a confrontation on Sunday in a suburb of the city, authorities said. Abdul Ballout, a German citizen with Lebanese roots, was killed following a search that lasted nearly 24 [...]

item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] Thune faces mounting Trump reconciliation pressure heading into summer sprint
item.description: Senate Majority Leader John Thune (R-S.D.) is facing deepening pressure from all sides — especially President Trump — as he prepares to navigate a packed to-do list headlined by a government funding bill and third reconciliation bill. The Senate is closing in on its last two weeks before an extended recess, which could set the [...]

item.title: [WATCHLIST: evacuation] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Wildfires in France drive 250,000 people from their homes and creep toward wine city of Bordeaux
item.description: A raging wildfire in southwest France forced the evacuation of 55,000 people overnight Sunday, bringing the total forced out of their homes to a staggering 220,000 in one region alone.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: evacuation] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Bradenton fire chief says timing prevented injuries in roof collapse
item.description: A roof collapse at Aviata at Bradenton Villas forced the evacuation of 157 residents Saturday night. No injuries were reported.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Teen passenger dies after SUV fleeing trooper crashes at 115 mph on SR-54: FHP
item.description: A high-speed chase on State Road 54 ended with a crash into a utility pole and tree, leaving one teenage passenger dead and another seriously injured.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Residents safe and relocated after partial roof collapse in Aviata at Bradenton Villas
item.description: After a scary evening at the Aviata at Bradenton Villas, more than 150 residents were safely relocated to sister facilities within the region.
